name: docdoc
description: Foreground document scanning, page review, and a single-file archive

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && esbuild src/renderer/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=renderer/app.js --external:./pdfjs/pdf.mjs --log-level=warning
scripts.test: npm run build && for t in qrbill invoices blank preocr metadata pursuit correspondence metadata_model storage scanner pdf_export document_split autosave pipeline; do ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 node_modules/electron/dist/electron dist/tests/test_$t.js || exit 1; done && python3 python/test_pdf.py
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && xvfb-run -a node_modules/.bin/electron dist/tests/test_ui.js
